item.title: Sunprint to Story: Cyanotype as Collage
item.description:
Sat 3 Oct, 10:00 AM · Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre · $145|$140 Members
Join local mixed media artist Sue Bradshaw for a hands-on workshop making cyanotype sunprints and collage. You’ll unite light, objects and paper to create a visual story. Open to all skill levels, this workshop invites you to bring small objects and images to weave into your story. If you are not sure where to begin, Sue will offer inspiration, guidance, and a range of examples to spark ideas. By day’s end, each student will leave with a finished sunprint story of their own.

item.title: Inspector Drake & The Black Widow by BATS
item.description:
Fri 25 Sep, 7:30 PM · Buderim War Memorial Community Association, 50 Burnett Street · See link
BATS THEATRE COMPANY PROUDLY PRESENTS - INSPECTOR DRAKE AND THE BLACK WIDOW Imagine if Fawlty Towers meets a murder mystery. That is, essentially, Inspector Drake and the Black Widow. A classic English farce featuring a cross between ‘Inspector Clouseau’ and ‘And Then There Were None’ will have you laughing out loud and forgetting about the outside world. A dead body is found, whilst dusting at 3am, which sets up a play that is an amusing parody of the whodunnit genre, that’s packed with lots of visual gags, subtle adult innuendo, all topped with a touch of cross-dressing. The plot, set in the 1920s , has Sergeant Plod send for the infamous Inspector Drake to help solve the murder of John Johnson who has been stabbed in the back whilst wearing his wife’s dress. The two are thwarted by a series of women who look suspiciously alike, with triplets born two months apart, a missing semi-tropical spider and a lustful widow. Just a few of the obstacles facing Inspector Drake. Imagine Basil Fawlty playing Inspector Clouseau playing Inspector Drake? What can possibly go wrong? From the Team at BATS Theatre, that brought you ‘Sex Please, We’re Sixty’. PERFORMANCE DATES: Friday, 25 September 2026 at 7.30pm Saturday, 26 September 2026 at 2.00pm and 7.30pm Friday, 2 October 2026 at 7.30pm Saturday, 3 October 2026 at 2.00pm and 7.30pm

item.title: Michael St George
item.description:
Sat 3 Oct, 6:00 PM · The Presynct Venue & Bar, Nambour · See link
MICHAEL ST GEORGE + ROOTS N BLOOM Jamaican roots. Reggae. Dub. Spoken word. Conscious music. The Presynct welcomes internationally acclaimed Jamaican-born Michael St George for a special night of roots reggae, dub poetry, rhythm and powerful storytelling. Born in Portland, Jamaica and raised in Kingston, Michael St George is a poet, singer, songwriter and renowned dub performance artist whose music brings together roots reggae, spoken word, world rhythms and jazz, carrying messages of social justice, connection, universal love and positive change. With a career spanning decades and continents, Michael has performed and collaborated with artists across Jamaica, Canada and Australia, including OKA, Dennis Bovell, Earl “Chinna” Smith and Ollie McGill of The Cat Empire. In Australia, he has toured with OKA, collaborated on their The Sunset Sessions, performed at the Sydney Opera House and was the closing act at GARMA 2017. Joining Michael are Sunshine Coast special guests ROOTS N BLOOM - a collective of women brought together through music, culture and community. Their beautiful vocal harmonies, global influences and heartfelt storytelling create music centred around connection, joy and belonging. Together, Michael St George and Roots N Bloom make this a night built around reggae, roots, soul and community - uplifting live music with something to say. Come early, grab a drink and settle in for a night of conscious music and positive vibes. 📅 Saturday 3rd October ⏰ Doors 6:00pm (Happy Hour) | Event Doors from 7:00pm 🎟 General $35+BF | Door $40 🔞 18+ Event 🩴 NO Thongs Permitted 🚱 NO Outside Drink bottles

item.title: Maleny Community Centre 2026 Annual General Meeting
item.description:
Wed 30 Sep, 10:30 AM · Maleny Community Centre Verandah Room · See link
The AGM is an opportunity to reflect on the past year, celebrate our achievements, and look ahead to the future of the Centre. We are delighted to welcome Dave Southern as our guest speaker. Dave led the team that designed and hand-carved the magnificent timber entrance doors to the Main Hall—one of the Centre’s most recognisable and treasured features. He will share insights into his artistic journey, his work as a woodcarver, and the inspiration behind his craft. Dave will also assist in a special unveiling. We hope you can join us for what promises to be an enjoyable and inspiring morning as we celebrate our Centre, its history, and the people who have contributed to its success. Date: Wednesday 30th September 2026 Time: 10.30am Venue: Verandah Room, Maleny Community Centre

item.description:

EMOWAVE AT THE PRESYNCT The eyeliner is back. The anthems never left. Get ready for a full night of emo and pop punk nostalgia as EMOWAVE at The Presynct takes over Nambour for one massive celebration of the songs that defined a generation. Headlining the night are Forever On High, one of the Gold Coast's rising alternative acts, bringing their explosive live show and soaring anthems to The Presynct. They'll be joined by Dirty Hearts and No Clue, before we hand things over to the DJ to keep the energy going until midnight. Expect wall-to-wall emo, pop punk and alternative classics from artists including: My Chemical Romance • Paramore • Fall Out Boy • Bring Me The Horizon • A Day To Remember • Blink-182 • Linkin Park • Sleeping With Sirens • Sum 41 • All Time Low • Green Day • Panic! At The Disco • Good Charlotte • Bullet For My Valentine • Escape The Fate • The Amity Affliction • Falling In Reverse • Bad Omens and many more. Whether you grew up blasting these bands on your iPod or you've only just discovered them, this is your chance to sing every word, relive the glory days, and lose yourself in a night of unforgettable music. Live Music Forever On High Dirty Hearts No Clue After the Bands Our DJ will keep the party alive with the biggest emo and pop punk anthems right through until midnight. Dust off the band tees, lace up the Converse, gather your crew and prepare for a night of heartbreak, nostalgia and loud singalongs. This is The Presynct Goes Emo. item.title: Veteran Family Fun Day 2026
item.description:
Sun 20 Sep, 2:00 PM · Maroochy RSL · See link
Maroochy RSL is proud to host a special day of family-friendly fun in honour of our current and former serving personnel and their families. This FREE community event promises a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere with something for everyone, including a live band, magician, competitions, prizes, balloon artist, face painting and light refreshments. Complimentary beer, wine and soft drinks will be available, with a licensed area on site for the purchase of additional beverages. Admission is FREE. Bookings are essential. GET YOUR FREE TICKETS HERE Proof of ADF service is required upon entry. Accepted forms of identification include: • Current Maroochy RSL Member, Life Subscriber or Life Member card • RSL Sub Branch card (members of other Sub Branches) • Australian Defence Force ID • Defence Force discharge papers (must be presented with photo ID such as a driver’s licence) • DVA Gold, White or Orange Card (must be presented with photo ID) Each Veteran is entitled to bring one adult guest and up to four children . If you require additional guests, please contact info@maroochyrsl.com.au prior to the event.
